These are the mods I maintain, plus one cart.

Gen1AutoSave is already listed here. I left its version alone since the
release job handles that, and filled in the metadata the rest of these carry.

Some of this is other people's work that I took and tweaked, and the credit
stays with them. Gen1Follower is built from Antigravity and gamecorner33's
PokePC Followers. Gen1ModernBag is a derivative of FAFF0x's Modern Bag, taken
at upstream 1.6.0, and carries its MIT notice verbatim. The item icons in
Gen1ModernBag and Gen1WildUI are Polished Crystal's, by Rangi42 and that
project's graphics contributors. Gen1Arena's backdrops are the Battle
Backgrounds Patch FR. Each mod's CREDITS.md has the full attribution and
travels with the assets. None of it is ROM-derived.

Wild Green pins four published builds and mirrors none of them.

Tell me if any of it needs changing.
